content.instruction: Use 225000ms for supported Herdr status/completion waits and reuse the same pending wait/process instead of starting repeated 45000ms waits. Keep host/API execution yielded so actual user input can still be handled. This does not change provider timeouts/retries, source/effect admission, model policy or stopping boundaries. Pull durable results on completion or material phase change, not repeated status prompts.
